title: ficus retusa var. rigo
intro: Ficus retusa var. rigo, commonly known as the Malabar chestnut or Bael tree, is a plant species that has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Ficus retusa var. rigo include its use in treating various digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dysentery, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, inhibit the growth of microorganisms, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Ficus retusa var. rigo include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
